title: Pages
intro: Organise your site's pages: where they sit in the menu, their address in French and in English, and the blocks that make them up.
projectsIntro: A project gathers your images on a board. It is visible on the site only if a page displays it. You can also create one directly on a page's canvas. Drag the cards to choose their order on the site.
homeIntro: The home page of your site.
draftCorrupt: This page's draft can no longer be read (a block has changed). Open the visual editor to start again from the live version before saving here.
draftPending: This page has unpublished changes in the visual editor. “Save” here only changes the information: your content changes stay pending until “Publish”.
createIntro: The page is created unpublished: you build it in the editor, then “Publish” in the editor puts it online.
titleEnHelp: Optional: the French title is used otherwise.
trashIntro: A deleted page is no longer on the site or in the menu. It stays here for {days} days: restore it in one click, after which it is erased for good.
erasedIn: erased in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
missingAlt: {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} without a description (for visually impaired people and Google). To be completed in the media library.
notInMenuToast: This page is live but does not appear in any menu: use “Add to menu”.
untranslatedToast: {label}: English-speaking visitors will see these passages empty or in French.
menuHelp: Drag pages by their handle, or use the keyboard: Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space to drop.
unpublishedChangesTitle: Changes made in the editor have not been published yet.
toastOffline: “{title}” taken off the site: it is no longer visible
toastLiveNoDraft: “{title}” is live, without its unpublished changes
notInMenu: This page is live but does not appear in any menu
specialsHelp: The site displays them itself: you build their content like a page's, but they have no menu entry and no address to share.
specialOfflineTitle: The site goes back to the original error page.
toastSpecialOffline: “{title}” taken off the site: the original error page is back
blockedIntro: This page is used by {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}: remove these links before deleting it.
deleteKeep: It leaves the site and the menu, but stays in the trash for {days} days: you can find it there again or undo right afterwards.
draftKept: Its editor draft is kept; its unpublished changes to projects or to the header (social links, footer) are discarded.
